_comment: Pinned differences between the engine and desktop for presets-parity.mjs. A combination listed here passes only if its G-code differs from desktop's in exactly these lines, and fails once it matches (then remove the entry).

known.combo: Wanhao D9-400 MK2 0.4 nozzle | 0.12mm Fine @Wanhao D9 | Bambu PLA Marble @System
known.note: One M73 progress line (remaining time 14 → 13 min) comes one short move (0.46 mm) earlier than on desktop; every move is identical. So the two print-time estimates differ slightly where they cross that minute boundary. Ruled out: FMA contraction (desktop's estimator has no FMA instructions, the engine builds with -ffp-contract=off) and libm (the estimator calls only sqrt here; this G-code has no arcs). Cause not yet found.
